notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); the package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or real-simulator run is claimed. Both card entry symbols exist at the pinned commit: one_policy_to_run_them_all/environments/multi_robot/create_env.py:15 (create_env) and one_policy_to_run_them_all/environments/anymal_b/environment.py:27 (class AnymalB(gym.Env)). The card's helper is MujocoDriver, so this package serves the card's models[0], one_policy_to_run_them_all/environments/anymal_b/data/anymal_b.xml, through a model path relative to this package; it does not import or run the clone. The upstream AnymalB environment path requires RL-X, gymnasium, dm_control and pygame, which are not installed and cannot be installed here (no network, no pip); the served interface is the MJCF's own twelve-motor torque control (action.ctrl), not AnymalB.step's twelve-element joint-position action and Rudin2022 PD conversion, and cap.world.reset.v1 restores the compiled model defaults rather than AnymalB.reset's 0.5 m drop pose. Those differences are stated in the fidelity gaps; they follow from serving the card model through the card's declared helper, not from a changed entry symbol. The model compiles to 19 qpos values (7 free base + 12 hinges), 18 qvel values (6 + 12) and 12 motor actuators, each with ctrlrange -40.0..40.0 inherited from the default motor at anymal_b.xml:56; the bridge derives and enforces those bounds before mj_step. The MJCF states no timestep, so the served step and the published fidelity use MuJoCo's 0.002 s default; the shipped anymal_b configuration sets 0.005 s and AnymalB integrates four substeps per 50 Hz control step (disclosed in the gaps). MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed (no network, no pip), so backends['fake'] is the package's stand-in mujoco module (fake.py, FakeMujoco). It parses the MJCF defaults for the free base, the hinges, the motors and their ctrlrange, and integrates a placeholder hinge velocity proportional to ctrl with no mesh, contact, inertia, gravity, constraint, damping or actuator dynamics; no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine. The fake exposes no mj_getState/mj_setState, so its snapshots use the bridge's basic profile; the real engine's full integration-state codec was not run. WARNINGS kept from the last gate run (all expected, none failed): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library rather than a package class the gate can record; G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. TESTS: test_driver.py keeps the required mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds eight cases (model shape and defaults, control-range refusal with no effect, ctrl length, step advancing the integration state, reset to the model defaults, reset seed recorded without changing the model, published fidelity, e-stop latch); all nine tests pass. No catalogue_requests: the package uses only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1. No site-limits.example.json is needed because there is no driver-declared Limit and no operator-required bound; the control envelope is derived from the model at load time. The fake returns the full 19/18/12 state and control arrays, not a reduced stand-in. No human reviewed this package and no hardware was tested.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Reviewed both card entries, the ANYmal B MJCF and its 19/18/12 state/control dimensions, inherited -40..40 motor bounds, valid free-base reset quaternion, stop behavior and MIT provenance. Updated driver.py and facts.md to give the fake its own F0 engine contract, correct the velocity-array and padded-action-space facts, narrow the keyframe wording and disclose retained controls after a stop. Corrected test_driver.py's fidelity assertion, which failed before the fix and passed afterward. Regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the fake gate including repository tests and the strict collector pass with only the documented simulator-family warnings. For the human reviewer: The served contract is the bare ANYmal B MJCF with torque inputs, not the Gymnasium position-offset action, PD controller, reward or vectorized task. Model-default reset and the 2 ms step differ from the environment's drop pose and 5 ms physics setting. The fake is F0; no real engine or physical robot was run. The latch retains ctrl, reused by a later explicit step without action.
